terms.comment: A country takes a preposition: in Asiam Minōrem, in Asiā Minōre, ex Asiā Minōre. The phrase is Orosius’s; Anatolia.

terms.gloss: the Roman province of Asia, in the west of Asia Minor
evidence: M-O s.v. Asia Minor (Cic.; Verg.; Sen.)
terms.comment: In Cicero Asia is usually the province; the adjective Asiānus belongs to it (Lewis & Short).

phrases.english: let us fly to the famous cities of Asia

sources: Lewis & Short: Asia
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. Asia Minor.
